# Sharke

> Sharke is a grant-verification and funding-pipeline platform for US nonprofits. It measures whether a grant-funded plan can actually fund the mission (the Funding Gap), verifies each opportunity against primary-source evidence before staff time is committed, and builds a Verified Pipeline. Sharke returns categorical, source-cited decisions (Pursue, Wait, or Move on). It does not predict or guarantee awards.

## What Sharke is
- Verification, not discovery. A grant search or database hands you names. Sharke checks each opportunity against eligibility, funder award history, geography, timing, and organization size before your team invests the hours to apply.
- The Funding Gap is the distance between what your mission needs from grants and the funding your current pipeline can realistically support.
- The Verified Pipeline is what survives verification, each entry backed by the public record.
- General-purpose AI can help discover and draft. Sharke verifies the opportunity before the expensive work begins.
